# Agentic AI Engineer — Exercise Sheets

Work in tables of 3–4. Each lab ends with something written down that you take back to work.

## Lab 1 — Single agent with 3 tools

*Module 1: Agent architecture · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 1** (`python demos/01_single_agent_three_tools.py`): Implement the same task in your framework of choice. Print every THINK/ACT/OBS. How many steps did it take? What is your termination condition?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 2 — Build and vet an MCP server

*Module 2: Tools and MCP · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 2** (`python demos/02_tools_and_mcp_vetting.py`): Write the manifest for one internal MCP server you would like (three tools). Run the vetting checklist. Which tool would you refuse to expose in week one?

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 3 — Memory tiers

*Module 3: Memory · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 3** (`python demos/03_memory_tiers.py`): Decide for your agent: what goes in working memory, what is written to long-term, and who can delete it. Test recall of a preference after 20 turns.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 4 — Red-team your agent

*Module 4: Reliability and safety · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 4** (`python demos/04_red_team_your_agent.py`): Add a seventh drill that reflects your own worst fear for your agent. If no cap stops it, you have found this week's work.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 5 — Trajectory eval suite

*Module 5: Evaluation of agents · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 5** (`python demos/05_trajectory_evals.py`): Write five trajectory tests for your agent: expected tools, forbidden tools, max steps. Run them on every prompt change.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.

## Lab 6 — Capstone

*Module 6: Multi-agent and computer use · about 96 minutes*

**With demo 6** (`python demos/06_supervisor_workers.py`): For your capstone: justify in three sentences why you need more than one agent. If you cannot, build one agent with better tools.

**Write down:** 1) what you tried · 2) what the result was · 3) one thing you will do differently at work this month.
